# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was known to dress up in a white collar when driving his buggy on rare outings. In his coffin, he is described as having long gray hair framing a placid face with a kindly smile.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew was an exceptionally shy, silent, and quiet man who hated speaking to strangers or going among crowds. He was soft-hearted, indulgent, and deeply sympathetic, taking a fond delight in listening to Anne talk. Though considered odd by those around him, he possessed a contented, gentle nature and a secret love for old-fashioned flowers.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c14 P50](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0050), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

- to keep Anne at Green Gables and support her happiness  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c14 P50](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0050)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla, rarely leaving home due to his extreme shyness. One June afternoon, he set off for Bright River to fetch an orphan boy to help on the farm, only to find Anne Shirley waiting instead. Captivated by her charm and vivid imagination, Matthew supported keeping her at Green Gables, taking her side during difficulties and enjoying her company. He continued to farm his land until he died instantaneously from the shock of reading about the failure of the Abbey Bank. He was mourned deeply by Anne, Marilla, and the town of Avonlea before being buried from his beloved homestead.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_
